exact_policy.note: P0/P1 se miden contra el indice completo; S2 retira aliases solo para medir recuperacion de candidatos y P2 nunca auto-resuelve fuzzy.

fuzzy_policy.reason: A bounded benchmark cannot make fuzzy similarity authoritative; hard negatives remain review-only even if a threshold has zero observed errors.

benchmark.reranker_recommendation: NONE: every tested RapidFuzz reranker reduced Recall@10 versus the best native FTS5 rank
